BLOCKED on landing (not on implementation): Gerrit change #2436 (typed mutation payload union + comparator) has LLM-Review +1 (PASS) but Verified has failed 5 consecutive CI runs, all on the identical single test tests/unit/test_audit_serve_heldout.py::test_serve_binds_loopback_ephemeral_and_lists_ticket ("Network access is forbidden..."), across all 3 Python versions each time.

This is a pre-existing flake unrelated to this change's files (mutation_payloads.py, payload_shadow.py, mutation.py share no code/imports/fixtures with the audit-serve test). Root-caused and tracked separately as ignitable-noteworthy-osprey (edeb-c3ad-c051-4e6a, discovered_from this ticket). Evidence: passes 100% in isolation locally; reproduces identically under CI's exact full-suite -n4 --dist worksteal invocation locally; an unrelated dependency-sweep CI job also failed in the same time window with a completely different signature, consistent with shared-runner contention.

Per AGENTS.md's flaky-test policy (root-cause, don't blindly retry), I stopped after 5 identical failures rather than continue rechecking. This ticket's own dependency change (#2435, the corpus) is already MERGED. Change #2436 needs a human operator to either fix/quarantine the flaky audit-serve test or make the call on landing #2436 despite it (a repo-admin decision I cannot make). All implementation, tests, corpus, and gates for e9d5 itself are complete and green locally (lint, typecheck, complexity ratchet, module-size, full regression suite). The ticket cannot be transitioned to closed until #2436 is Verified +1 and merged (the completion-verifier's file-impact check requires a commit for this ticket reachable from origin/main).
